name: Mate in 1
description: Deliver checkmate in one move.

name: Mate in 2
description: A forced checkmate in two moves.

name: Mate in 3
description: A forced checkmate in three moves.

name: Long mate
description: A forced checkmate in four moves or more.

name: Back-rank mate
description: Mate on the back rank, where the king is boxed in by its own pawns.

name: Smothered mate
description: A knight mates a king surrounded by its own pieces.

name: Fork
description: One piece attacks two valuable targets at once.

name: Pin
description: A piece can't move because the king would be exposed behind it.

name: Skewer
description: A valuable piece is attacked and must move, exposing the piece behind it.

name: Discovered attack
description: Moving one piece unveils an attack by another.

name: Double check
description: Two pieces give check at once, so the king must move.

name: Sacrifice
description: Give up material to get something bigger.

name: Quiet move
description: A calm move, with no check, capture or direct threat, that sets up the win.

name: Promotion
description: A pawn reaches the last rank.

name: Win material
description: The line ends with you ahead in material.

name: Endgame
description: Few pieces left on the board.

name: Long combination
description: A line of five moves or more.

name: Pawn break
description: Push a pawn to challenge the opponent's pawn chain.

name: Prophylaxis
description: Stop the opponent's plan before it starts.

name: Improve a piece
description: Reroute or activate a badly placed piece.

name: The right exchange
description: Trade the pieces that make your position better.

name: Outpost
description: Plant a piece on a strong square the opponent can't easily challenge.

name: Open file
description: Open a file or take it over with the rooks.

name: Good and bad bishops
description: Keep the bishop pair, lose your bad bishop, or exploit the opponent's.

name: Pawn weaknesses
description: Create or target weak pawns: isolated, doubled, backward or hanging.

name: Passed pawn
description: Create, push or stop a passed pawn.

name: Attack on the king
description: Start or strengthen an attack against the king.

name: Space
description: Gain space and restrict the opponent's pieces.

name: Centre
description: Fight for the centre or strike at it.

name: Exchange sacrifice
description: Give a rook for a minor piece for a lasting advantage.
